features.provenance: Anchored to the OSM-matched route pose at 1,371.735 m (source capture 54 s). Uses the existing OSM hipped-house footprint/style and two shared CC0 tree meshes; the fence face is a rectified crop from the 4K frame. Building/tree offsets, fence run length and source-camera calibration remain approximate.

Apex points back toward the approach. Width was estimated by comparing the source-frame triangle with the mapped 7 m road (about 3 m); its 2.0 m forward and +0.5 m road-right offsets are informed by the frame registration. Camera-local ray/depth fit is uncertain (about 2 m trajectory RMS), so these are authoring estimates, not surveyed values.

Transverse line position and near-center lateral offset are estimated from frame 114 s and the registered camera pose; the line remains 2.0 m beyond the triangle base. Camera/local-depth alignment has about 2 m RMS uncertainty; dimensions and placement are not surveyed.
